distanthorizons.setting.enabled.tooltip: Toggle Distant Horizons level-of-detail terrain rendering.
distanthorizons.setting.render_distance_: Maximum distance in chunks at which Distant Horizons renders simplified terrain.
distanthorizons.setting.horizontal_quali: Controls how quickly distant terrain transitions to coarser detail levels.
distanthorizons.setting.vertical_quality: Maximum stacked vertical layers kept per column for caves, overhangs, arches and Nether caverns.
distanthorizons.setting.distant_generati: Sample terrain beyond loaded chunks using the world generator.
Worldgen detail level for distant ungenerated chunks (Surface, Carvers, Features or Full Light).
distanthorizons.setting.cave_culling_ena: Skip hidden underground cave layers below the cave culling height in sunlit dimensions.
distanthorizons.setting.cave_culling_hei: Y level below which hidden underground caves are culled from distant terrain.
distanthorizons.setting.fog_enabled.tool: Blend distant terrain smoothly into the horizon sky fog.
distanthorizons.setting.noise_enabled.to: Add subtle per-block luminance variation to untextured distant terrain.
Strength of surface texture variation on distant terrain.
distanthorizons.setting.overdraw_prevent: Fraction of vanilla render distance kept clear before starting LOD transition.
distanthorizons.setting.fade_enabled.too: Dither-fade LOD terrain smoothly across the vanilla render distance boundary.
Shade distant terrain faces by direction and height.
distanthorizons.setting.brightness_multi: Scales distant terrain brightness relative to vanilla lighting.
